page.overview:
Who is Calphayus' wife?

A female citizen of the Sith Empire was the wife of Sith Lord Calphayus prior to him becoming one of the Dread Masters. After all Dread Masters except him had been killed, Calphayus remembered his prior life and regained memories of his wife.
